title: Clarify the two DPI-H layers and their depiction in figures
requirements:
- State what 'two layers' covers relative to applications, foundational DPI and cross-cutting enablers in later figures
- Visually separate and label the two DPI-H layers
- Provide simplified audience-specific views alongside the full traceability view
- Show and name the shared data and business-services layers in 3.3
- Apply distinct, consistent colours with a legend in Figures 3.3–3.5
- Clarify which enabling services (audit, consent, trust, terminology) are components and which are foundational
- Rename 'Metadata registries' to match its contents, and replace the ambiguous 'application layer'
- Place the EMR in the point-of-service tier consistent with its classification elsewhere
